key_insight: First-principles calculations predict ferroelectric ground states in 11 of 15 [111]-oriented perovskite-oxide superlattices, with octahedral rotations substantially affecting ferroelectric properties in some cases.
engineering_relevance: The findings can guide orientation and composition choices for ferroelectric oxide heterostructures, but do not establish solar-cell performance or an AI application.
method: Calculate ground-state structures of 15 free-standing oxide superlattices from first principles.
Analyze zone-center phonons, ferroelectric distortions, octahedral rotations, and force constants.
Compare thermodynamic stability for [111] and [100] growth orientations.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports ferroelectric ground states in 11 of 15 calculated superlattices, without experimental validation or photovoltaic efficiency measurements.
watch_item: Predictions for free-standing structures may change under substrate strain and other device-integration conditions.
paper_title: Properties of [111]-oriented ferroelectric superlattices based on oxides with a perovskite structure
